description: Windows disk defragmentation and optimization utility with a background agent service.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O Defrag MSI was not found: ' + $msi) }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "O&O Defrag installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

$entries = @(Get-ItemProperty -Path $uninstallRoots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq 'O&O Defrag Professional' -and $_.Publisher -eq 'O&O Software GmbH' -and $_.PSChildName -match '^\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}$' })
if ($entries.Count -ne 1) { throw "Expected exactly one registered O&O Defrag MSI product, found $($entries.Count). Refusing to remove Scoop files." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "O&O Defrag uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Nonportable: installs O&O Defrag's system-wide background agent service. Installation and removal require administrator approval; a restart may be required.
